- Restructure sidebar header: Back link left, Specification eyebrow + title right
- Align sidebar and center pane header vertical spacing consistently
- Match ReasoningTrigger and TaskTrigger font sizes (both text-xs)
- Add Cmd+Enter / Ctrl+Enter to submit question card textarea
- Replace Answered pill badge with round checkmark indicator
- Remove italics and quotes from answered card response text
- Update sidebar test for shortened back link text
